instruction: Compare the flat JSON objects in/old.json and in/new.json. For each key in sorted order write one line to out/changes.txt: '- key: <old>' if removed, '+ key: <new>' if added, '~ key: <old> -> <new>' if the value changed (values JSON-encoded, e.g. strings in double quotes). Unchanged keys produce no line.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
